prompt: Ella: a slender adult woman, always airborne. Tall pointed witch hat with a wide brim, its tip bent over and curling back. Long wavy dark brown hair streams loose past her waist. A dark cloth mask covers her whole face; two small gold eye glints are its only light. A separate long ragged scarf with two tails. Fitted buttoned dark jacket with belt, long sleeves, layered skirt with sawtooth hems to the knee, knit stockings, laced boots, gloves, every inch covered. The umbrella is the only object she holds: an open shallow dome two-thirds as wide as she is tall, eight gores alternating mid umber (#5C473E) and light taupe (#B9A892), never black, scalloped hem; a long thin dark shaft ending in a narrow pierced diamond; at the peak a short dark stem on a small collar ends in one round bead with a tiny point. Both gloved hands grip the shaft. Pose first: level side view facing right, Ella falls slowly, seated in the air as if on a swing, torso upright, thighs forward, knees bent, shins and boots hanging down. Both gloved hands hold the shaft level in front of her waist; the open canopy is held out ahead at arm's length like a shield, finial pointing right, scalloped rim toward her; the diamond points left behind her hip. Hair and scarf stream back left. Three figures in a row, 21:9, level camera, same scale, 60% of canvas height, green between them. They differ slightly: canopy tilted a few degrees up, level, a few degrees down; hems drifting. The attached image shows only her open umbrella; copy its design. Dark etched storybook engraving for a 2D sprite: brown-black ink, sepia wash, fine cross-hatching. Mid-tone umber and taupe cloth (#3A2C25, #5C473E, #7A6558), pale taupe (#B9A892) on scarf and gloves; near-black only as hairline ink; the hat crown dark umber, not black. A thin 2 px outline in warm apricot-cream (#FFE6C4); gold only in the two eye glints and one small highlight. Flat pure green #00FF00 background, edge to edge, empty. Figure colours: umber, taupe, cream, a trace of gold; pale cream only on the scarf, never on skirt or jacket. Wordless.
